mods.name: tree
mods.description: Adds /tree: tracked files as a tree, 2 levels deep, folders with file counts (80 lines at most). Read-only.

mods.name: deps
mods.description: Adds /deps: direct dependencies with versions from package.json, pyproject.toml, requirements.txt, go.mod and Cargo.toml at the repo root. No network, no audit. Read-only.

mods.name: authors
mods.description: Adds /authors: the top 15 contributors by commit count with their last commit date. Names only, never email addresses. Read-only.

mods.name: scripts
mods.description: Adds /scripts: runnable tasks from package.json scripts, Makefile targets, justfile recipes and pyproject scripts. Read-only.

mods.name: env-check
mods.description: Adds /env-check: variable names in .env.example against .env, listing missing and extra names. Reads names only, never a value. Read-only.

mods.name: explore-pack
mods.description: Five read-only repo exploration commands in one mod: /tree, /deps, /authors, /scripts and /env-check.
